# Screenshot designing checklist (review template)

**Agents:** Do not edit this file under `.claude/skills/screenshot-designing/`. After each **`pull-preview`** and/or **`pull-export`**, use this structure in your reasoning or paste into the user message when they need a sign-off. A one-line “looks good” **does not** replace explicit PASS/FAIL per row.

**Rules:** Use the **exact** `##` headings below. Replace `—` with real values from the run (`panel_index`, export path, `predict-checks` excerpt).

---

## 0. Active scope (single-panel default)

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Active `panel_index` (0-based) | — |
| Cross-panel exception | **no** (default) or **yes** — if yes, one-line rationale: — |

Unless **Cross-panel exception** is **yes** with a rationale, this review pass covers **only** the active panel’s composition; ops in the last batch should have targeted that column only.

---

## 1. Automated gate (`predict-checks`)

Run from repo root after saving full-strip export JSON (recommended):

`python toolkit/scripts/layout.py predict-checks --json <path-to-export.json> --from-export`

For carousel copy where **all title/subtitle/description must live in one strip column**, add **`--require-text-single-panel`** (multi-panel strips only).

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Export JSON path | — |
| `ok` | — |
| If not ok: paste `errors` (truncate if huge) | — |

---

## 2. Toolkit criteria (per active panel)

_Map failures to `predict-checks` errors where possible._

| Check | PASS / FAIL | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text layers: no bbox overlap with each other **in the same strip column** | — | — |
| Text: inside safe zone / margins for its panel | — | — |
| Text: contrast vs background (export-driven) | — | — |
| Text: horizontal span **20–25%** of panel width (dominant panel) | — | — |
| Text vs device: **no** bbox overlap | — | — |
| Device height **75–90%** of canvas (panel) height | — | Per device |
| Device pairs: Jaccard IoU **≤ 0.30** | — | Global strip |
| Optional: all text same column (`--require-text-single-panel`) | — | — |

---

## 3. Visual polish (active panel)

| Check | PASS / FAIL | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hierarchy readable (title → subtitle → body) | — | — |
| Spacing and alignment feel intentional | — | — |
| Device + text story matches `output/screenshot_report.md` for this panel order | — | — |

---

## 4. Next actions

- If any **FAIL**: list numbered `enqueue-op` fixes for the **active panel** (or document cross-panel ops + rationale), then re-export and re-run §1–§3.
- If all **PASS** and §1 `ok`: advance to the **next** `panel_index` until every panel is done, then ship.
